body:
Cloud setup update for lead Astra 6.1 Max Orchestrator completion, thread 01a108c2-6050-7f43-b050-ed1e24a7f63f.

Owner instruction: you lead this small team. Route all cloud questions here and going forward to you; ask the owner only when necessary. Reuse existing credentials. Target remains a new isolated cloud profile.

Mailbox is operational: branch codex/cloud-team-mailbox-20261004 contains README.html and mailbox.py. The helper supports both directions and correlated replies, tested with independent Git clients and concurrent writers. Read with mailbox.py --repo YOUR_CHECKOUT read --to lead; reply with send --from lead --to cloud --reply-to 9cc06b4e394e41c090c3935f7b86acc6 --body-file YOUR_REPLY_FILE. No direct thread wake-up is available. Please acknowledge through the mailbox when received.

Final full test run: 4385 tests; 4313 passed, 71 skipped, zero assertion failures, one error. Error is test_director_release.ReleasePreparationTests.test_sibling_guard_consumes_actual_compose_rendering: installed Docker Compose v2.40.3 serializes bind.create_host_path=false as bind={}, and the repository release validator rejects this equivalent rendering. Source remains unchanged; this requires separate compatibility work. Earlier PowerShell PATH failures are resolved. Test log: /workspace/director-cloud/tests-final.log. Test lane was stopped through its owning script after completion.

Working services: Python 3.12 FastAPI development service with SQLite, and isolated n8n with its PostgreSQL database. HTTP health, unauthorized rejection, authenticated intake, persisted preview plan, owner-decision stop and repeatable recovery passed. n8n readiness and UI HTTP requests passed. Requirements, syntax, workflow JSON and provider profiles validated. Install script rerun succeeded. All tracked application files remain unchanged.

Blocked live integrations: no provider/Slack credential bindings on this cloud machine, no existing local credential files. GitHub Git read/write works using platform authentication; GitHub API requests return Forbidden. Do not extract runtime Codex authentication. Need existing credential store/binding locations, distinct new-profile Slack app/channel/owner identifiers, reachable Claude routine/host bridge endpoints, and applicable signed activation/independent review/CI/security/entitlement/budget evidence. No secret values in this mailbox or chat. Bind existing secrets using secure environment settings.

Environment draft saved: install_script, start_skill, non-secret requirements, nine proxy secret declarations and their destination allowlist additions. Draft saving does not apply, execute or publish. Review and save environment settings, then publish only when the desired setup scope and limitations are accepted. Live connections and fresh-task restoration are not verified.
